<quote by="Proposed: Morrow, Seconded: Skarsind ">To build a citadel in the region of Peregro, in the territory of Morrow, to stand watch over the border of Therunin where the Druj and vallorn hold sway. Also a disbursement of funds.</quote>

==Cost==
